window: about 30 days to 11 Nov 2026, plus standing items still live
note: Titles and snippets only. Nothing here is an approved fact. Every figure must be re-read from the primary page in deep research.

candidates.topic: SIP in a falling-market month: contributions kept rising while SIP assets fell
candidates.why_now: AMFI's September 2026 note shows monthly SIP contribution up 0.6% on the month and SIP assets down 4.1% on the month on mark-to-market losses. AMFI's monthly page already lists October 2026, so the freshest note should be used.
candidates.audience: MFDs reassuring SIP clients during volatility
candidates.risk: Low. Educational, no scheme names, no performance claim. AMFI's own page has a 'Total during FY' row that looks one month behind its cumulative row, so confirm figures against the monthly note.

candidates.topic: RBI's October rate hike and the shift to 'calibrated tightening': what it means for debt-fund and FD conversations
candidates.why_now: At its 5 to 7 October 2026 meeting the MPC raised the repo rate by 25 bps to 5.50% and changed the stance to calibrated tightening, after holding at 5.25% in August.
candidates.audience: MFDs and RIAs advising conservative and debt-fund clients
candidates.risk: Medium. Easy to drift into predicting rates or recommending debt funds. Must stay on what changed and how rate moves generally affect bond prices.

candidates.topic: Specialised Investment Funds (SIFs) explained for distributors
candidates.why_now: Several SIF long-short fund filings appeared on SEBI between 29 Oct and 6 Nov 2026, SEBI's May 2026 circular added a separate MCR format for SIFs, and AMFI now reports SIF flows monthly.
candidates.audience: MFDs asked by HNI clients about SIFs
candidates.risk: Medium to high. Complex product, needs scheme-name discipline (none named), and the distributor label rules for SIFs apply.

candidates.topic: SEBI (Mutual Funds) Regulations, 2026: what the 10 October second amendment changes
candidates.why_now: The 2026 regulations took effect 1 April 2026 and were amended again on 10 October 2026.
candidates.audience: MFDs and RIAs wanting a plain summary
candidates.risk: High. Only the title was seen, not the content. Legal wording must be read in full before anything is claimed.

candidates.topic: Retirees are taking up SIPs: older investors' share of SIPs has risen sharply
candidates.why_now: AMFI-Crisil Factbook 2026 says the share of SIP investors above 58 rose from 11.4% to 20.6%, and the 18 to 34 share held near 32.7%.
candidates.audience: MFDs and RIAs serving retirees and near-retirees
candidates.risk: Low to medium. Snippet was fragmentary: confirm the exact period and what the percentages measure before use.

candidates.topic: Inflation and real returns: why CPI matters to a client's goal
candidates.why_now: MoSPI releases October 2026 CPI on 12 Nov 2026, the day after this scan. CPI now uses the 2024=100 base introduced in February 2026. Best published after the release.
candidates.risk: Medium. Timing-dependent, and any 'real return' example needs a performance figure and therefore a disclaimer.
